propositions: an optional isolated adapter mines local Claude Code session transcripts via error-signature grep to reconstruct environment/integration history, with output labeled low-confidence and quarantined behind a backfill script
the adapter uses deterministic regex/keyword classification (no LLM call) to route matched error patterns to an enum (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none)
emitted records carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate these values from authoritative structural metrics
the core metrics registry and command must not import the transcript adapter (portability guard enforced by unit test scanning source for the adapter import)
unit tests exercise both the adapter classification determinism over fixture JSONL and the backfill script's end-to-end invocation over a fixture transcript directory
